WITH inspection_groups AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT group_id FROM keiro.keiro_projection_rebuild_groups WHERE $1::text IS NULL ORDER BY group_id LIMIT $2) SELECT status.*, coalesce(cursors.subscription_names, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS feeding_subscriptions FROM inspection_groups page CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT group_id,
       lifecycle_phase,
       reads_allowed,
       writes_allowed,
       serving_revision_id,
       serving_epoch,
       serving_position_basis,
       serving_applied_position,
       active_run_id,
       candidate_revision_id,
       candidate_rebuild_position,
       candidate_rebuild_head,
       query_models,
       rebuild_started_at,
       last_promoted_at,
       failed_at,
       failure_code,
       failure_detail
FROM keiro_read.projection_group_status_v1 WHERE group_id = page.group_id OFFSET 0) status LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT subscription_names FROM keiro.keiro_projection_group_cursors WHERE group_id = page.group_id AND status.serving_position_basis = 'checkpoint' OFFSET 0) cursors ON true ORDER BY status.group_id
